Prawn cocktail for the whole hotel.d: Six, poached and chilled, on shredded iceberg with a rosy tomato mayonnaise and lemon. Paprika.
Prawn cocktail for the whole hotel.note: For the whole hotel, if you like.

Caviar blini.d: Warm buckwheat pancakes, crème fraîche, salmon roe and chopped chives.
Caviar blini.note: Made to order. Allow twenty minutes.

Surf and turf.d: An eight ounce filet mignon cooked to your liking and a lobster tail, split and broiled in garlic butter. Béarnaise on the side.
Surf and turf.note: Our most requested dinner. Thirty dollars even.

Rare stamp shortbread.d: Butter shortbread with a pinked edge, each piped with an iced stamp. Six to a plate.
Rare stamp shortbread.note: Postcards and stamps are at the front desk.

Monty's champagne cocktails for the bar.d: A sugar cube soaked in bitters and a dash of orange liqueur, then chilled brut to the brim and a twist of peel.
Monty's champagne cocktails for the bar.note: By the glass, or by the tray for your guests.
